about: Money: saving, debt, insurance, investing, scams, windfalls and crashes.

en..x: How much of every paycheck should go straight into a low-cost index fund? You won't see it, so you won't spend it.
en..p.s: About {a} a year now, rising as your pay rises.
en..0.s: Keep all of it. Whatever is left over sits in the bank.

zh..x: 每份薪水要拿多少直接投进低成本指数基金？看不到的钱，就不会被花掉。
zh..p.s: 现在每年约{a}，工资涨它也跟着涨。
zh..0.s: 全部留着。剩下的钱放在银行里。

zht..x: 每份薪水要拿多少直接投進低成本指數基金？看不到的錢，就不會被花掉。
zht..p.s: 現在每年約{a}，工資漲它也跟著漲。
zht..0.s: 全部留著。剩下的錢放在銀行裡。

opts.do: debt += a; happy += 3; const t = T('cc', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.cc') }); t.spent += a; t.g += a

en..x: A bank offers you your first credit card, with a {a} limit. Anything you don't pay off costs 18% a year.
en..full: Use it, and pay in full every month
en..full.s: No interest, as long as you stay disciplined.
en..min: Spend on it and pay the minimum
en..min.s: About {a} of clothes, gadgets and nights out now. Happiness +3.

zh..x: 银行给你办第一张信用卡，额度{a}。没还清的部分，每年利息18%。
zh..full.s: 只要有纪律，就不用付利息。
zh..min.s: 现在花大约{a}买衣服、电子产品和出去玩。幸福感 +3。

zht..x: 銀行幫你辦第一張信用卡，額度{a}。沒繳清的部分，每年利息18%。
zht..full.s: 只要有紀律，就不用付利息。
zht..min: 刷卡消費，只繳最低應繳
zht..min.s: 現在花大約{a}買衣服、3C和出去玩。幸福感 +3。

opts.label: p ? M('.p', {p: pc}) : M('.0')
opts.sub: p ? M('.s.' + k, {a: MN(c), m: MN(k === 'US' ? Math.min(p, sc.match) * sal : sc.rel * c)}) : M('.0.s.' + k)
opts.do: if (p) { scheme = {p: p, match: sc.match, rel: sc.rel, lot: sc.lot}; mkLot(sc.lot, {rate: sc.rate, lock: k === 'US' ? 60 : 55}, sc.lk) }

en..x.US: Your employer matches whatever you put into your 401(k), up to 5% of your pay. The money is invested in the stock market and locked until you retire.
en..x.MY: On top of the compulsory EPF, you can top up your EPF account yourself. EPF has paid about 5–6% a year (about 3% after inflation) with little risk. The money is locked until 55.
en..x.SG: You can top up your CPF Special Account. It pays 4% a year (about 2% after inflation) with no risk, and every top-up cuts your income tax. The money is locked until 55.
en..s.US: About {a} a year from you, plus {m} a year from your employer.
en..s.SG: About {a} a year. Your tax bill falls by about {m} a year.
en..0.s.US: Keep all your pay now, and leave your employer's match on the table.

zh..x.US: 你放进401(k)的钱，公司会等额配对，最多到工资的5%。这笔钱投资股市，退休前不能动。
zh..x.MY: 除了强制的公积金，你还可以自愿往EPF账户里加钱。EPF过去每年约派5–6%（扣除通胀约3%），风险很低。钱要到55岁才能取。
zh..x.SG: 你可以填补CPF特别账户。年利率4%（扣除通胀约2%），没有风险，每次填补还能减所得税。钱要到55岁才能取。
zh..s.US: 你每年约存{a}，公司再给你{m}。
zh..s.SG: 每年约{a}。每年少缴约{m}的税。
zh..0.s.US: 现在全部工资留在手上，公司的配对就白白放弃了。
zh..0.s.MY: 现在全部工资留在手上。
zh..0.s.SG: 现在全部工资留在手上。

zht..x.US: 你放進401(k)的錢，公司會等額提撥，最多到薪水的5%。這筆錢投資股市，退休前不能動。
zht..x.MY: 除了強制的公積金，你還可以自願往EPF帳戶裡加錢。EPF過去每年約配息5–6%（扣除通膨約3%），風險很低。錢要到55歲才能領。
zht..x.SG: 你可以填補CPF特別帳戶。年利率4%（扣除通膨約2%），沒有風險，每次填補還能減所得稅。錢要到55歲才能領。
zht..s.US: 你每年約提撥{a}，公司再給你{m}。
zht..s.SG: 每年約{a}。每年少繳約{m}的稅。
zht..0.s.US: 現在全部薪水留在手上，公司的提撥就白白放棄了。
zht..0.s.MY: 現在全部薪水留在手上。
zht..0.s.SG: 現在全部薪水留在手上。

opts.do: spend('bnpl', a, 'trk.bnpl'); happy += 3; later(age + 1, 'late', { a: .5 * a })

later.late: if (roll('late') >= .42) return; pay(x.a); const t = trk.bnpl; if (t) { t.spent += x.a; t.g += x.a; } log(M('log.late', { a: MN(x.a) }), 'bad')

en..x: You want a new gaming setup that costs {a}. The shop lets you pay in four parts with no interest.
en..now: Buy it now in four payments
en..now.h: About 4 in 10 people miss a payment and pay late fees.
en..save: Save up and buy it in a few months
en..save.s: Same price, paid from savings. Happiness +2.

zh..x: 你想要一套{a}的新游戏设备。店家让你分四期付款，零利息。
zh..now.h: 大约十个人里有四个会漏付一期，被收滞纳金。
zh..save.s: 一样的价钱，用存款付。幸福感 +2。

zht..x: 你想要一套{a}的新電競設備。店家讓你分四期付款，零利率。
zht..now.h: 大約十個人裡有四個會漏繳一期，被收逾期費。
zht..save.s: 一樣的價錢，用存款付。幸福感 +2。

emerg.do: const r = evR('em'); later(age + 2 + Math.floor(r() * 4), 'emerg', {a: (.25 + .25 * r()) * base})

opts.do: efund = efTarget(); T('efund', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.efund'), note: M('note.efund0') }); emerg()

later.emerg: const c = Math.min(Math.max(0, cash), x.a), d = x.a - c; cash -= c; debt += d; const t = trk.efund; if (t && d < 1) t.note = M('note.efund', { a: MN(x.a) }); log(M(d >= 1 ? 'log.emergDebt' : 'log.emergCash', { a: MN(x.a), b: MN(d) }), d >= 1 ? 'bad' : 'good')

en..x: Six months of basic costs comes to about {a}. Car repairs, layoffs and family emergencies happen to almost everyone.
en..build.s: Part of your savings goes into a high-interest account until it holds {a}. Only then do you invest.
en..skip.s: More money in the market. If something happens, it goes on the credit card.
en.note.efund0: Your buffer earns interest instead of losing to inflation

zh..x: 六个月的基本开销大约是{a}。修车、失业、家里出事，几乎每个人都会遇到。
zh..build: 存够6个月的紧急备用金
zh..build.s: 一部分存款先放进高息账户，直到存满{a}，之后才拿去投资。
zh..skip.s: 更多钱在市场里。万一出事，就刷信用卡。
zh.note.efund0: 备用金有利息，不会被通胀吃掉

zht..x: 六個月的基本開銷大約是{a}。修車、失業、家裡出事，幾乎每個人都會遇到。
zht..build: 存夠6個月的緊急預備金
zht..build.s: 一部分存款先放進高利活存，直到存滿{a}，之後才拿去投資。
zht..skip.s: 更多錢在市場裡。萬一出事，就刷信用卡。
zht.note.efund0: 預備金有利息，不會被通膨吃掉

en..x: Your friends are planning two weeks abroad.
en..local: A cheaper trip closer to home
en..skip.s: Your savings stay where they are.

zh..x: 朋友们计划出国玩两个星期。
zh..local: 去近一点、便宜一点的地方

zht..x: 朋友們計畫出國玩兩個星期。
zht..local: 去近一點、便宜一點的地方

opts.do: insured = true; T('ins', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ins'), prem: 0, saved: 0, note: M('note.ins0') })

en..x: A policy costs {a} a year and covers 85% of big medical bills. You feel fine.
en..yes.s: A fixed cost every year. Protects your savings from a big bill.
en..no.s: Keep the money. If something happens, you pay the whole bill.

zh..x: 一份保单每年{a}，可以报销85%的大额医疗费。你现在身体很好。
zh..yes.s: 每年固定开销。万一有大额账单，可以保住你的存款。
zh..no.s: 省下这笔钱。万一出事，账单全部自己付。

zht..x: 一份保單每年{a}，可以報銷85%的大額醫療費。你現在身體很好。
zht..yes.s: 每年固定開銷。萬一有大額帳單，可以保住你的存款。
zht..no.s: 省下這筆錢。萬一出事，帳單全部自己付。

go.do: pay(x); T('lend', { kind: 'custom', label: M(lk), v: -x, note: M('note.lend0', { a: MN(x) }) }); const r = roll('lendAt'); later(age + 2 + Math.floor(r * 4), 'repay', { a: x, id: 'lend' })

en..x: A close friend asks to borrow {a} and promises to pay you back.
en..h: About half of loans to friends are paid back in full.
en..no.s: Your money is safe, but the friendship cools. Happiness −1.

zh..x: 一个好朋友想跟你借{a}，保证会还。
zh..h: 借给朋友的钱，大约只有一半能全数还回来。
zh..no.s: 钱是保住了，但友情淡了。幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 一個好朋友想跟你借{a}，保證會還。
zht..h: 借給朋友的錢，大約只有一半能全數還回來。
zht..no.s: 錢是保住了，但友情淡了。幸福感 −1。

opts.do: pay(.12 * base); T('mlm', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.mlm'), v: -.12 * base, note: M('note.paid', { a: MN(.12 * base) }) }); rec('mlm', .04 * base, 3); later(age + 3, 'mlm')

later.mlm: const ok = roll('mlm') < .1, t = trk.mlm; if (ok) { const v = .5 * base; cash += v; earned += v; if (t) t.v += v; } if (t) t.note = M(ok ? 'note.mlmOk' : 'note.mlmNo', { a: MN(Math.abs(t.v)) }); log(M(ok ? 'log.mlmOk' : 'log.mlmNo'), ok ? 'good' : 'bad')

en..x: An old classmate says they are now a "diamond leader". You can join their team with a {a} starter kit, then recruit your friends.
en..join.s: Pay {a} for the kit, plus about {b} a year in stock for 3 years.
en..join.h: Most people in schemes like this lose money.
en..buy: Buy one product to be polite
en.trk.mlmBuy: Bought a product to be polite

zh..x: 一个老同学说自己现在是“钻石领导”。花{a}买入门套装就能加入团队，然后再拉朋友进来。
zh..join.s: 套装{a}，之后3年每年还要进货约{b}。
zh..join.h: 参加这类计划的人，大多数都亏钱。

zht..x: 一個老同學說自己現在是「鑽石經銷商」。花{a}買入會套組就能加入團隊，然後再拉朋友進來。
zht..join.s: 入會套組{a}，之後3年每年還要進貨約{b}。
zht..join.h: 參加這類直銷計畫的人，大多數都賠錢。

en..x: Your phone is three years old, and the new flagship has just come out.

zh..x: 你的手机用了三年，新的旗舰机刚上市。

zht..x: 你的手機用了三年，新的旗艦機剛上市。

en..x: A friend swears a new coin will go up ten times. Half your group chat is already in.
en..small.s: {a}. Money you can afford to lose.
en..skip.s: Keep your money where it is.
en..no: You have almost no savings to bet.

zh..x: 朋友发誓说有个新币会涨十倍。群里一半的人已经买了。
zh..no: 你几乎没有积蓄可以赌。

zht..x: 朋友發誓說有個新幣會漲十倍。群裡一半的人已經買了。
zht..no: 你幾乎沒有積蓄可以賭。

opts.label: M('.try', { a: MN(a) })
opts.do: pay(a); T('scam', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.scam'), v: -a, note: M('note.scamIn', { a: MN(a) }) }); later(age + 1, 'scam', { a, id: 'scam' })

en..x: You are added to a chat group where members post screenshots of 3% profit a week. A friendly "mentor" offers to help you get started.
en..try.s: The app shows your balance growing fast.
en..try.h: It is a scam. The money will not come back.

zh..x: 你被拉进一个聊天群，群里的人天天晒每周赚3%的截图。一位热心的“导师”说要带你入门。

zht..x: 你被拉進一個聊天群組，群裡的人天天曬每週賺3%的截圖。一位熱心的「老師」說要帶你入門。

opts.do: get(); cash -= a; addLot('bonus', a); T('lot_bonus', { kind: 'lot', src: 'bonus', label: M('trk.bonusInv') })

en..x: You had a great year at work, and you get a bonus of {a}.
en..inv.s: All of it into an index fund.
en..treat.s: Spend it on something special. Happiness +4.
en..bank.s: Safe, but slowly eaten by inflation.

zh..x: 你今年工作表现很好，拿到{a}的奖金。
zh..treat.s: 买点特别的东西。幸福感 +4。
zh..bank.s: 安全，但会被通胀慢慢吃掉。

zht..x: 你今年工作表現很好，拿到{a}的獎金。
zht..treat.s: 買點特別的東西。幸福感 +4。
zht..bank.s: 安全，但會被通膨慢慢吃掉。

opts.do: ilp = { amt: .08 * base, until: age + 20 }; mkLot('ilp', { fee: .025 }, 'trk.ilp')
T('term', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.term') }); rec('term', .015 * base, 25); termTo = age + 25; happy += 2

en..x: An agent offers you a savings plan with life cover: {a} a year for 20 years, with "guaranteed" returns and a payout at the end.
en..ilp: Sign up for the savings plan
en..ilp.h: Fees take about 2.5% of the fund every year.
en..term: Buy cheap term life cover instead
en..term.s: About {a} a year for 25 years. Your family is protected if you die; otherwise nothing comes back. Peace of mind: Happiness +2.

zh..x: 一位经纪向你推荐带寿险的储蓄计划：每年{a}，缴20年，“保证”回报，到期还有一笔钱。
zh..ilp.h: 每年的费用大约吃掉基金的2.5%。
zh..term.s: 每年约{a}，保25年。你万一不在，家人有保障；否则什么也拿不回来。图个安心：幸福感 +2。

zht..x: 一位業務員向你推薦附壽險的儲蓄險：每年{a}，繳20年，「保證」回報，期滿還有一筆錢。
zht..ilp.h: 每年的費用大約吃掉基金的2.5%。
zht..term.s: 每年約{a}，保25年。你萬一不在，家人有保障；否則什麼也拿不回來。圖個安心：幸福感 +2。

go.do: pay(a); for (const q of parts) { mkLot(q[0], q[2], q[3]); addLot(q[0], a * q[1]) }

en..x: You have {a} that you won't need for 10 years or more.
en..index.s: About 5% a year after inflation on average, with crashes along the way.
en..gold.s: Holds its value over long periods. Pays no interest. Moves on its own, not with stocks.
en..fd.s: A fixed rate of about 3.5%, roughly 0.5% after inflation. No risk.

zh..x: 你有{a}是10年以上都用不到的。
zh..index.s: 扣除通胀后平均每年约5%，中途会遇到股灾。
zh..gold.s: 长期能保值，没有利息。涨跌跟股票不同步。
zh..fd.s: 固定利率约3.5%，扣除通胀约0.5%。没有风险。

zht..x: 你有{a}是10年以上都用不到的。
zht..index.s: 扣除通膨後平均每年約5%，中途會遇到股災。
zht..gold.s: 長期能保值，沒有利息。漲跌跟股票不同步。
zht..fd.s: 固定利率約3.5%，扣除通膨約0.5%。沒有風險。

events.text: crashP > 1 ? M('.x', { p: crashPct(), a: MN(crashP) }) : M('.x0', { p: crashPct() })
events.pre: const m = crashM || .62; for (const k in lots) if (isMkt(lots[k])) lots[k].v *= m; for (const k in trk) if (trk[k].kind === 'ghost') trk[k].g *= m; crashP = eqTot()
events.preLog: M('log.crash', { p: crashPct(), x: crashP > 1 ? M('log.crashX', { a: MN(crashP) }) : '' })

opts.do: cash -= a; addLot('dip', a); T('lot_dip', { kind: 'lot', src: 'dip', label: M('trk.dip') }); crashTrack('hold')

en..x: Stocks fall {p}% in a few weeks. Your investments are now worth {a}. The news says it will get worse.
en..x0: Stocks fall {p}% in a few weeks. You don’t own any, but layoffs are rising.
en..sell.s: Turn {a} into cash and stop the bleeding. You buy back in 3 years.
en..sell.no: You have no investments to sell.
en..hold.s: Do nothing. Markets have always recovered, but nobody knows when.
en..buy.s: Move {a} of bank savings into stocks at low prices.
en..buy.no: Not enough cash in the bank.

zh..x: 几个星期内股价跌了{p}%。你的投资现在只值{a}。新闻说还会更糟。
zh..x0: 几个星期内股价跌了{p}%。你没有股票，但裁员越来越多。
zh..sell.s: 把{a}换成现金，及时止损。3年后再买回来。
zh..hold.s: 什么都不做。股市最后总会回升，只是没人知道什么时候。
zh..buy.s: 把银行里的{a}趁低价买进股票。

zht..x: 幾個星期內股價跌了{p}%。你的投資現在只值{a}。新聞說還會更糟。
zht..x0: 幾個星期內股價跌了{p}%。你沒有股票，但裁員越來越多。
zht..sell.s: 把{a}換成現金，及時止損。3年後再買回來。
zht..hold.s: 什麼都不做。股市最後總會回升，只是沒人知道什麼時候。
zht..buy.s: 把銀行裡的{a}趁低價買進股票。

opts.do: cash -= a; addLot('idle', a); T('lot_idle', { kind: 'lot', src: 'idle', label: M('trk.idle') })

en..x: You have {a} in the bank. After inflation it loses about 1% a year.
en..keep.s: Safe from crashes. Slowly eaten by inflation.

zh..x: 你银行里有{a}。扣除通胀后，它每年大约缩水1%。
zh..inv: 拿去投资，留6个月备用金
zh..keep.s: 不怕股灾，但会被通胀慢慢吃掉。

zht..x: 你銀行裡有{a}。扣除通膨後，它每年大約縮水1%。
zht..inv: 拿去投資，留6個月備用金
zht..keep.s: 不怕股災，但會被通膨慢慢吃掉。

en..x: You're 40. You invest {p}% of every paycheck.

zh..x: 你40岁了。你每份薪水投资{p}%。

zht..x: 你40歲了。你每份薪水投資{p}%。

opts.do: pay(base); life = .95; happy += 5; const t = T('life', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.lifeUp') }); t.spent += base; t.g += base
life = .65; happy -= 3; T('life', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.lifeFrugal') })

en..x: Your friends are moving to bigger homes, newer cars and fancier holidays.
en..up.s: {a} now on a renovation, then you spend 95% of spare money instead of 85%. Happiness +5.
en..same.s: Spend about 85% of spare money, like now.
en..frugal.s: Spend 65% of spare money and save the rest. Happiness −3.

zh..x: 朋友们都换了大房子、新车，还去更高级的地方度假。
zh..up.s: 现在花{a}装修，之后闲钱从花85%变成花95%。幸福感 +5。
zh..same.s: 跟现在一样，闲钱大约花85%。
zh..frugal.s: 闲钱只花65%，其余存起来。幸福感 −3。

zht..x: 朋友們都換了大房子、新車，還去更高階的地方度假。
zht..up.s: 現在花{a}裝修，之後閒錢從花85%變成花95%。幸福感 +5。
zht..same.s: 跟現在一樣，閒錢大約花85%。

zht..x: 你的父母過世了，留給你{a}。

zht..spend: 環遊世界，再買輛夢想中的車
zht..bank.s: 安全，但會被通膨慢慢吃掉。

move.do: let x = 0; for (const k in lots) { const l = lots[k]; if (!isMkt(l)) continue; const y = l.v * f; l.v -= y; l.tout += y; x += y; } if (to) addLot(to, x); else cash += x

en..x: You have {a} in stocks. A big crash just before or after you retire hurts most, because you have to sell to live.
en..stay.s: The highest average return, and the biggest swings.
en..mix.s: Bonds pay about 1.5% a year after inflation and swing much less.
en..cash.s: No swings, but inflation eats it.

zh..x: 你有{a}在股票里。退休前后遇到大股灾伤害最大，因为你得卖股票过日子。
zh..stay.s: 平均回报最高，波动也最大。
zh..mix.s: 债券扣除通胀后每年约1.5%，波动小很多。
zh..cash.s: 没有波动，但会被通胀吃掉。

zht..x: 你有{a}在股票裡。退休前後遇到大股災傷害最大，因為你得賣股票過日子。
zht..stay.s: 平均報酬最高，波動也最大。
zht..mix.s: 債券扣除通膨後每年約1.5%，波動小很多。
zht..cash.s: 沒有波動，但會被通膨吃掉。

opts.label: M('.buy', { a: MN(a) })
opts.do: pay(a); annu += .07 * a; T('annuity', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.annuity'), v: -a, cost: a, note: M('note.annuity', { a: MN(a), b: MN(0) }) })

en..x: An insurer offers to turn a lump sum into a fixed income for as long as you live.
en..buy.s: Pays {b} a year for life. The lump sum is gone, even if you die early.
en..no.s: You keep control of the money, but it has to last.

zh..x: 保险公司提议把一笔钱换成终身的固定收入，你活多久就领多久。

later.cosign: const t = trk.cosign; if (roll('cosign') < .3) { pay(x.a); if (t) { t.v -= x.a; t.note = M('note.cosignPaid', { a: MN(x.a) }); } rl(-6); log(M('log.cosignPaid', { a: MN(x.a) }), 'bad'); } else { if (t) t.note = M('note.cosignOk'); log(M('log.cosignOk'), 'good'); }

en..gift: Say no, but give {a} to help

'log.bizpalWin' : f ? 'log.bizpalBack' : 'log.bizpalFail', { a: MN(x.a), b: MN(v) }), f ? 'good' : 'bad')
